calc.batteryDataNote: PROVISIONAL battery spec (2026-10-09). avgPowerDrawKw and chargerPowerKw were BLANK on the owner sheet, so they are BACK-DERIVED from this platform's existing [estimate] runtime and charge time: draw = usable kWh / runTimeHr, charger = usable kWh / chargeHr. They therefore inherit that estimate's uncertainty and are NOT measurements -- `batterySpecProvisional` is set so every surface can say so. Replacing them with the real figures is the whole fix: six cells across the three platforms completes the library. Chemistry (TPPL), voltage, capacity and usable% are ALSO unverified -- highlighted yellow on the owner sheet -- so the whole chain is provisional, not just the two derived cells.
